Initial release of phy-competitor-watch — a social media competitor content strategy analyzer.

- Analyze JSON exports of competitors’ social media posts to reveal their full content strategy.
- Breaks down topic distribution, content styles (listicle, story, contrarian, etc.), posting schedule, and top-performing patterns.
- Identifies exploitable gaps: topics and styles competitors do NOT cover.
- Easy to use: no API keys or external dependencies required.
- Works with any platform’s exported post data.
